complete_examples.text: However, Monte-Carlo simulation (MCS) [37] is proved to be time-consuming and is also difficult to obtain the time-dependent responses of the system [14,38].

The statistical results of the lateral acceleration of car body caused by lateral earthquake and track irregularities collected by 796 representative samples are compared with the ones performed by Monte-Carlo simulation (MCS) with 20,000 samples, as shown in Fig. 9.
